params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry is twisted, bent or tapered.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: Twist rotates slices about the axis, Bend curves the shape along the axis, and Taper scales slices so one end narrows and the other widens.

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.description: The axis the deformation runs along. The middle of the geometry's extent on this axis stays still and the two ends deform in opposite ways.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: Strength of the deformation over the geometry's full length: radians of rotation for Twist and Bend, change in scale for Taper. Negative reverses it.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: Point group to deform; other points stay where they are. Empty deforms every point.
